Marcelle Meyer (piano) Documented

Named in the file attribution and in the discography of the complete Rameau keyboard recordings.

[1] [7]
Work version
Complete keyboard piece and its two doubles, performed on piano Documented

The original is for harpsichord. Meyer’s edition is unidentified. The three large sections follow the theme and two doubles; their times are broad passage guideposts.

Commons applies PD-old-70-expired to the composition. The modern Gouin engraving is consulted as a research source and is not redistributed here.

Recording rights
Public domain in the European Union under Commons’ PD-EU-audio designation Documented

The host’s licence field is Public domain. Commons separately warns of continuing US protection for this pre-1972 sound recording; the territorial EU designation is not worldwide clearance.

Jean-⁠Philippe Rameau, Les Niais de Sologne with two doubles; Marcelle Meyer, piano, Paris, 29–⁠30 October 1953. Les Discophiles Français DF 98/99; Médiathèque musicale Mahler collection; Commons upload by Flopinot2012. Commons PD-EU-audio; US recording restrictions remain. Rights statement
